answer: Random peer audits stop bulk fake identities. Each epoch, every agent gets two randomly chosen auditors, each staking a copper coin worth 20 POA before checking the other's work. A river of new identities faces the same check, so none escapes. An auditor who passes a fake loses the coin; colluding auditors lose both, so fakes cannot hide like water in karst rock. Making 100 fakes risks 2,000 POA; an honest agent risks one coin and keeps earning.
